discoverySentence.text: Weapons stop automatically aiming and instead attack along your facing direction with greatly increased damage and Area.

acquisition.method: found in a relic cache through map exploration

unlock.effect: Permanently adds the relic to the random relic-cache selection pool; it neither equips nor guarantees that relic.

acquisition.cacheOpening: automatic on mech contact; freezes the complete gameplay simulation
acquisition.resolution: immediate install-or-sell; no relic inventory or deferred decision

rarityAndWeighting.selectionModel: three distinct relics drawn without replacement from the currently unlocked pool and assigned to the three caches during generation

stackingAndExclusivity.modifierOrder: Relic-specific multipliers apply after the additive percentage modifiers supplied by mech traits, utilities, and PowerUps unless the relic explicitly replaces targeting or cadence.

behaviorRegistration.registrationModel: Relics are cross-cutting policies registered by stable relic ID. They modify well-defined hook points rather than scattering ID checks through every weapon.
behaviorRegistration.perWeaponCompatibilityManifest: produced from tests; states fully affected, partially affected with disclosed reason, or invalid. The initial design expects no invalid pairing.

rules.text: Aimable weapons no longer select enemies or enemy concentrations. They fire, launch, or deploy along persistent mech facing using their ordinary range or placement distance.
Homing attacks lose homing after launch. Autonomous weapon units orient their attacks along the mech's sampled facing rather than choosing their own targets.
Mech-centered, orbiting, movement-laid, and other geometry that already lacks automatic aim keeps its normal origin and behavior.
All weapon damage increases by 75%, and every dimension classified as weapon Area increases by 40%, including weapons whose geometry was already non-aimed.
The relic adds no aim stick, cursor, fire button, or turn-in-place control. The player aims indirectly through the accepted movement-derived facing rule.
